Figure 1: Overview of SKILLGRAPH. The skill graph and the agent’s policy co-evolve through a closed loop: (1) graph construction distills skills and their typed relations (prerequisite, enhancement, co-occurrence) from trajectories; (2) graph-aware retrieval traverses these relations to produce dependency-ordered skill sequences that guide the policy; (3) graph evolution uses training feedback to refine skill nodes, adjust edge weights, and restructure the graph, which in turn improves future retrieval and policy learning.

Table 1: Main results on ALFWorld and WebShop. ALFWorld reports per-subtask and overall success rates (%); WebShop reports task score and success rate (%). Bold and underline denote the best and second-best results, respectively.
